reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified 4C as a water supply error from the first message, asked the right two questions (supply valve and hose kinks), correctly read the 90-degree valve position as closed, linked it to the plumber's work, and resolved the fault with no part or engineer needed. Conversation 2 ignored the 4C code entirely, ran irrelevant door/child-lock/delay-start checks, never asked about the water supply even after the customer volunteered 'no water in the tub' and recent plumbing work, and then wrongly diagnosed a 'start control system' fault requiring an engineer - an unsupported escalation for what was simply a closed isolation valve.
